name: Park and Activities Commission Adjourned Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  AUGUST 20, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 6:02 p.m. at Linden H. Chandler Preserve, 95 Buckskin
  Lane, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR MCCORMICK.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR MCCORMICK led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Ciarolla,  Johnson,  Bain,  Persichina,
  McCormick, and Holdsworth (joined at 6:04 pm)

  Commissioners Absent:  Pope

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF JULY 16,
  2024

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR
  PERSICHINA to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  JULY 16, 2024.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH joined the meeting at 6:04 p.m.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
August 20, 2024
   A.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM FUNDING REQUEST
  FROM ROLLINGWOOD HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION

  Superintendent Goldsmith gave a brief overview of the proposed street entryway
  beautification program funding request from the Rollingwood Homeowners
  Association (as per the agenda material).

  Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the City typically receives two street
  entryway beautification requests each fiscal year although it appears that the City
  may be able to accommodate three requests this year with what is currently
  budgeted. Supervisor Pinuelas added that if necessary, Staff can request a budget
  adjustment from City Council if any other projects come in that may exceed the
  current budget, in response to COMMISSIONER JOHNSON.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR
  PERSICHINA to:

  APPROVE THE ROLLINGWOOD HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION’S
  REQUEST OF $1,166 IN MATCHING FUNDS FROM THE CITY’S
  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM IN FY 2024-25.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  B.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM FUNDING REQUEST
  FROM DAPPLEGRAY LANES PROPERTY OWNERS ASSOCIATION

  Supervisor Pinuelas informed the Commission that the item would need to be
  tabled to a later meeting due to not having a quorum of Commissioners that do not
  reside in the Dapplegray Lanes Property Owners Association present for the item.

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  HILLS ARE ALIVE RACE DEBRIEF (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update about the 2024 Hills Are Alive Race that
  took place on Saturday, August 3. His update included the overall registration
  numbers and details regarding the day of the event. He stated that the event went
  well overall and noted that a full debrief report would be presented at the
  September meeting.

  Coordinator Morrow noted that there was a slight decrease in registrations this
  year compared to last year’s event, in response to COMMISSIONER JOHNSON.

  CHAIR MCCORMICK noted that a participant in the race stated that they felt the
  event t-shirt may not be a necessary give away and that maybe the City could look

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
August 20, 2024
   into another event giveaway item such as an event tote bag. Staff stated that they
  could look into the cost difference between those type of items.

  B.  CONCERT IN THE PARK DEBRIEF (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update about the Concert in the Park event that
  took place on Saturday, August 17. He noted that the event was well attended and
  that the band did a great job keeping the crowd entertained throughout the concert.
  He also noted that the Wetzel Pretzel food truck had mechanical issues that
  morning and was unable to attend the event.

  CHAIR MCCORMICK stated that he attended the concert with his family and
  agreed that it was well attended and that the band and stage and sound were
  great.

  Staff noted that they felt the attendance was a little bit smaller than last year’s
  concert, in response to CHAIR MCCORMICK.

  C.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  Superintendent Goldsmith stated that he was working on installing fencing in the
  baseball infields for the standard field maintenance at Ernie Howlett Park. He
  stated that he anticipates it being completed by the end of the week, in response
  to VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH stated that Rockbluff Park is looking good and
  has been busy this summer.

  Superintendent Goldsmith noted that the cleanup along the trails at George F
  Canyon is mostly completed, in response to CHAIR MCCORMICK.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JULY 9, 2024

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
August 20, 2024
   RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  ASSESSMENT OF SPACE FOR POTENTIAL DOG PARK AND FUTURE PARKS

  NONE.

  11.  PARK TOURS

  A.  LINDEN H. CHANDLER PRESERVE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas informed the COMMISSION that the representative from the
  PV Land Conservancy was unable to attend the meeting due to an unforeseen
  circumstance but is planning on attending the September meeting to provide an
  update regarding the preserve. No tour was pursued at this time.

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MCCORMICK ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 6:14 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON SEPTEMBER 17, 2024,
  AT 7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CITY
  HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  __________________________
  Matt Morrow  Ryan McCormick
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
August 20, 2024
